About This Degree
The PhD program in statistics and data scienceoffers training in cutting edge statistics, machine learning, data science, and artificial intelligence for students seeking careers in academe, industry, or government.
This program is unique in that it allows students to explore and specialize in topics across a wide spectrum of applied, computational, and theoretical problems in statistics and data science under the guidance of faculty dedicated to advancing methodology for important and timely real-world problems.
Many students work on collaborative research problems with faculty in other departments and at other universities.
